**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Bullock](../persons.html#221),	
I would have offered to write [Fletcher](../persons.html#1677)’s Life, but I have hunted all over the house twice over and cannot find the [book](../others.html#213) I once had, but no doubt you can get it from a library[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd J.F.

Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden.

Postmark Feb 24/94.

[^2]: CMY wrote several in a series of [\'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans\'](../books.html#358), which were intended to form part of Bullock\'s Daily Lections project, but were never published.
